note: Scripture is Cadman’s Kinh Thánh (1925), pasted by script where the author quotes a verse (Ps 37:23-24, 1 Thess 5:17, John 1:29, John 20:22, Eph 1:14, 1 Pet 3:15); his many echoes are rendered in his own words, with Cadman’s forms of names (Giê-hô-va Di-rê).

AI-translated (job #6173) in parallel chapters, then reconciled for one form per person, place and organisation (Học viện Hê-bơ-rơ Toronto, Hội Truyền Giáo Phúc Âm Liên Hiệp, YWAM, Vương quốc Anh, Chúa Nhật). Reader address bạn. Slips in the English kept as written and noted, among them dating inconsistencies in ch. 25, “Christo Rey” for Cristo Redentor, the dateline “west” of Australia, Dominica for Hispaniola, and Shimei for Shammai. Awaiting native review.
